definition_one_sentence: An account with at least one non-cancelled order in the last 12 months.
formula_or_rule: count(orders where status != 'cancelled' and order_date >= today - 12 months) >= 1
example: Last non-cancelled order 8 months ago -> active; 14 months ago -> not active.
notes_conflicts: Conflict settled: Sales wanted 6 months, Finance 12 months. Company standard = 12 months (board/investor reporting). Sales keeps a 6-month view under a separate term 'recently active customer'.

definition_one_sentence: Gross revenue minus refunds, excluding VAT; shipping fees are kept in.
example: 120 EUR paid, no refund -> 100 EUR net revenue.
notes_conflicts: Conflict settled: VAT is EXCLUDED (Finance). Sales commissions use a separate measure (gross - refunds, VAT included) = commissionable revenue, not 'net revenue'.

definition_one_sentence: A customer who was active before but has no non-cancelled order in the last 12 months.
formula_or_rule: has >=1 non-cancelled order ever AND last non-cancelled order_date < today - 12 months

definition_one_sentence: A unique account registered in ShopFast, identified by customer_id (one row in dim_customers).
formula_or_rule: one row per customer_id in dim_customers
notes_conflicts: One person may hold several accounts (duplicates seen in CTP 2): 'customer' = account, not person.

definition_one_sentence: A single purchase transaction placed by a customer, identified by order_id.
formula_or_rule: one row per order_id in fct_orders
notes_conflicts: A cancelled order is still an order (status='cancelled') but is excluded from the active-customer rule.
